description: Patch schema for FLUX.1 Kontext reference-latent image editing through local ComfyUI.

unmapped_ui_parameters.frames: The existing image-plugin frame control is preserved by the surrounding UI but this workflow emits one PNG per generate call.
unmapped_ui_parameters.guidance: Mapped to FluxGuidance.guidance, matching the official Comfy FLUX Kontext graph.
unmapped_ui_parameters.strength: The official reference-latent graph keeps KSampler denoise fixed. The image strength slider is preserved in UI and recorded by the plugin as unmapped until a certified strength-aware graph is available.
unmapped_ui_parameters.negative_prompt: FLUX Kontext's official reference graph derives negative conditioning by zeroing the positive prompt conditioning with ConditioningZeroOut.
unmapped_ui_parameters.inpaint_mask: The old plugin accepted an inpaint mask. Production exposure of masked inpaint is blocked until a separate local Comfy mask workflow is certified.
unmapped_ui_parameters.lora: Dynamic project LoRA injection remains visible in the Blender UI, but this certified graph does not load arbitrary LoRA files.
